clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Innkeeper Gryshka offers nougat to those who play along. During Hallow's End, she asks you to flex for a piece meant to cheer Spoops, a bedridden child.

Hallow's End brings pranks and sweet-gathering to Azeroth's capitals. In Orgrimmar's inn, Innkeeper Gryshka keeps holiday sweets for those who take part in the season's custom. You face dragons and dark sorcery in your travels, but here the bargain is simple: perform a trick or leave without a treat.

Innkeeper Gryshka wants a display of Orcish strength before she gives you Orgrimmar Nougat for young Spoops. Whatever disguise or armor you wear, she asks you to strike a muscular pose. Even the Horde's feared combatants can be made to entertain the common folk for candy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That's an... Interesting costume you have on. Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!
Let's see... You look so strong and buff in that... Costume... Let's see you flex! Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong friend!
When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat. It's a great Hallow's End treat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: No candy until you flex for me, friend...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are truly mighty, haha! Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport. Here's your candy.
